scope: Eight distinct open-source emulator additions for uncovered mobile, calculator, PDA, NeXT, Japanese 8-bit computer, and Spectrum Next platforms. Target system is recorded in platform and supported software in game.

projects.title: EKA2L1
projects.game: Symbian and Nokia N-Gage games, plus selected Symbian applications
projects.status: Part-time hobby maintenance; the maintainers say months may pass without active work. The current README reports support for almost all official N-Gage libraries and most S60v1–Symbian Belle games, with only a limited subset of Symbian applications.
projects.summary: Open-source Symbian/N-Gage emulator. It emulates the OS kernel and reimplements critical application servers and libraries; compatibility is strongest for games, and some apps remain unsupported.
projects.strategy: Symbian kernel emulation with reimplemented application servers and libraries
projects.subtype: Mobile OS and handheld gaming device emulator

sources.label: Maintainer README: emulated OS, host builds, compatibility, and maintenance cadence
Maintainer source repository and GPL-3.0 license
Maintainer release/build artifacts

projects.title: FreeJ2ME
projects.game: Java ME / J2ME MIDlets, including mobile games and applications
projects.status: Maintained source repository; latest repository activity was 2026-10-04. The project has no versioned GitHub release and its README describes compatibility as an ongoing goal rather than publishing a complete compatibility list.
projects.summary: Open-source Java ME emulator for running MIDlet JAR files. It supports standalone desktop use and separate SDL2 and Libretro integrations; the Java runtime and native bindings are built from the public source.
projects.strategy: Java ME virtual-device and MIDlet emulation
projects.subtype: Mobile software emulator; AWT, SDL2, and Libretro frontends

sources.label: Maintainer README: frontends, build steps, JAR loading, and compatibility roadmap
Maintainer license: GPL-3.0 for FreeJ2ME; bundled ASM has separate terms
Maintainer source repository and activity

projects.title: CEmu
projects.game: TI-84 Plus CE and TI-83 Premium CE calculator software
projects.platform: TI-84 Plus CE / TI-83 Premium CE
projects.status: Maintained; stable v2.0 and auto-updating nightly builds are available. The emulator requires a ROM dumped from a calculator the user owns and supports several ASIC/hardware revisions.
projects.summary: Developer-focused emulator for TI-84 Plus CE and TI-83 Premium CE calculators. Its project documentation describes accurate, fast emulation, USB transfer support, configurable hardware revisions, and debugging tools.
projects.strategy: Calculator system emulation with a C core and Qt-based desktop GUI

sources.label: Maintainer README: supported calculators, hosts, ASIC revisions, and ROM requirement
Maintainer release history: stable and nightly builds
Maintainer source repository

projects.title: Firebird Emu
projects.platform: TI-Nspire Touchpad, CX, and CX II families
projects.status: Community-maintained; the latest numbered release is v1.6 (2023), and the repository shows further source activity in 2026. The README lists Touchpad, CX, and CX II (-T/CAS) support; CX II boot ROM availability can limit booting.
projects.summary: Open-source, multi-platform TI-Nspire calculator emulator. The project supports desktop and mobile hosts, but a compatible calculator boot ROM is required and current CX II dumping tools may not provide all data needed to boot.
projects.strategy: TI-Nspire hardware and calculator OS emulation
projects.subtype: Calculator emulator with Android, iOS, desktop, and web-related builds

sources.label: Maintainer README: calculator models, host platforms, and ROM details
Maintainer release history
Maintainer source repository and GPL-3.0 license

projects.title: Previous
projects.game: NeXTSTEP, OPENSTEP, NetBSD, Plan 9, and selected compatible software
projects.platform: NeXTcube, NeXTcube Turbo, NeXTstation, and NeXTstation variants
projects.status: Maintained; official current downloads list Previous 4.5 for macOS/Windows and 4.4 for Linux, with source revision r1858. The project documents supported NeXT models and guest OS versions; some devices and third-party expansion boards remain unsupported.
projects.summary: Open-source NeXT computer emulator based on Hatari, using WinUAE’s m68k emulation core and a separate i860 emulator. The official compatibility page lists m68k NEXTSTEP through 3.3, OPENSTEP 4.0–4.2, NetBSD, and Plan 9; users supply the operating-system images.
projects.strategy: Full NeXT hardware emulation using m68k and i860 CPU emulation

sources.label: Official project site: models, guest operating systems, current builds, and limitations
Official source checkout and build instructions
Maintainer SourceForge source tree (revision r1858)

projects.title: QUASI88
projects.status: Maintained; v0.7.4 was released 2026-05-18 and the source repository shows activity through 2026-06-19. The project documents the PC-8801mkIISR model, CPU/video/audio, disk and cassette media, and modern desktop builds.
projects.summary: Open-source emulator for NEC’s PC-8801 family. The current SDL2-based port supports Windows, macOS, Linux, and Raspberry Pi packages and models the Z80 CPUs, display, sound, disks, tape, and peripherals.
projects.strategy: Software emulation of PC-8801 hardware and peripherals

sources.label: Maintainer README: supported models, hardware, host builds, and media formats
Maintainer release history
Maintainer source repository and BSD-3-Clause license

projects.title: JNEXT
projects.platform: ZX Spectrum Next Issue 2; ZX Spectrum 48K, 128K, and +3 modes
projects.status: Active; v1.1.51 was released 2026-10-13. The maintainer describes the emulator as unfinished and says extreme cycle-exactness is not the goal; the stated focus is development of Spectrum Next software.
projects.summary: Open-source ZX Spectrum Next emulator with a graphical debugger, headless/test automation, recording, and per-layer inspection. The project models the Issue 2 machine and boots NextZXOS from user-provided SD-card contents; known gaps remain documented.
projects.strategy: Hardware-focused software emulation cross-checked against the Spectrum Next FPGA reference sources
projects.subtype: Home-computer emulator focused on software development and debugging

projects.title: Einstein
projects.platform: Apple Newton MessagePad and eMate hardware families
projects.status: Maintained; v2026.10.13 was released on 2026-10-13. Officially supported hosts are macOS, iOS, and Ubuntu Linux; Android, Raspberry Pi, and Windows have partial support. A Newton ROM must be supplied by the user.
projects.summary: Open-source Apple Newton hardware and NewtonOS emulator. The project includes desktop and mobile applications, but it cannot distribute the copyrighted Newton ROM image required to boot.
projects.strategy: Newton hardware emulation and NewtonOS execution
